rows.name: overlayContainer
rows.description: A position:relative element the overlays (recent popover + full chat) portal into and anchor to. When omitted they render inline next to the bar.

rows.name: placement
rows.description: Default corner the full-chat panel anchors to on desktop (always inset from the corner). Users can move it at runtime via the panel's ⋮ menu.

rows.name: labels
rows.description: Override any user-facing copy — placeholder, headers, link text, and every aria label. Merged over the English defaults.

rows.name: persist
rows.description: Remember the chosen corner + panel size across reloads (localStorage). When off, the panel always opens at the defaults.

rows.name: persistKey
rows.description: localStorage key prefix used when persist is on.

rows.name: onSend
rows.description: Produce the assistant's reply to a sent message — wire your AI backend here. The thinking indicator shows until the returned value resolves. When omitted, a canned demo reply answers after a short delay.

rows.name: initialMessages
rows.description: Seed the conversation, e.g. history restored from your backend. ChatMsg is { role: "user" | "ai", text: string, at: Date }.
